check_out_success.doc: Stripe Checkout success return. UX-only: redirects the browser to the desk. Entitlement is applied by the payment.webhook service; the FE plan updates via the WS payment.plan_updated event.

session_id.doc: Stripe checkout session ID appended by Stripe on redirect. Not used (kept for URL compatibility).

check_out_cancel.doc: Stripe Checkout cancel return. UX-only: redirects the browser to the desk.

contact_invite.doc: Contact-invitation email links. UX-only same-site bounce, like portal_return, so the SameSite=Strict session cookie is sent: redirects to #/welcome/signin?contact_accept=&for= (invitation to an existing account) or #/welcome/signup?email=&contact_invite= (Join Drumee). The hash is rebuilt from validated values only.

open.doc: Generic same-site bounce for app links mailed out (service/lib/email-link.js bounceLink): redirects to `dest`, a path + hash on THIS host, so the SameSite=Strict session cookie is sent and is not replaced by a fresh guest one. `dest` must be a same-host absolute path from a URL-safe alphabet; anything else lands on the desk.

portal_return.doc: Stripe Billing Portal return. UX-only same-site bounce: redirects the browser to the desk so the SameSite=Strict session cookie survives the cross-site return (avoids apparent logout).
